about: Millennium Group International Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, provides paper-based packaging solutions in Mainland China, Hong Kong, Vietnam, the rest of Southeast Asia, Australia, the United States, and internationally. It operates in three segments: Packaging Products, Corrugated Products, and Packaging Products Supply Chain Management Solutions. The company offers paper packaging products, including raw papers, kraft papers, cardboards, carton papers, and corrugated paperboards for footwear products, sportswear, cookware and kitchenware, smartphones, home electronics, food and beverage, paper and packaging, non-food-and-beverage-consumables, logistics, and e-commerce applications. It also provides flexo and offset printing packaging products; packaging products supply chain management solutions; board games and its accessories, such as cards; and book production services, such as cover design and interior layout, printing, and binding services. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Kwun Tong, Hong Kong. Millennium Group International Holdings Limited operates as a subsidiary of YC 1926 (BVI) Limited.
